Combined retained selected scopes contain 22,829 capture occurrences and 9,966 distinct byte hashes, all available; support assets and duplicate captures remain identified. Edition count is not a raw-file denominator. The separate older LCV journal still has 70 capture events naming 69 missing historical hashes. Fresh October 27 LCV observations retain 69 originals and match none of those historical hashes. Availability does not newly qualify source interpretation or reproduce scores. Historical research found no exact older LCV originals; later archived methodology pages are unverified leads.

The bounded review checked 15,333 distinct provenance-qualified objects up to 1 MiB each. Other shapes, larger objects and records outside the provenance rule retain their prior classification; this review does not confirm them all as publisher originals. Original bytes and receipts remain retained, including the excluded processing evidence. Follow-up source-origin research located exact-byte capture receipts for 188 of 195 recognized originals, content-derived locations for three, and no exact locations for four FEC amendments. The shared empty payload remains excluded: 314 of its 491 aliases have candidate request receipts, 177 remain unresolved. Identical empty bytes do not establish a common acquisition URL.
